about: People's public keys for Lisbon Fringe (work/26). A person makes a key pair in their own browser at https://fringe.promptugal.news/me/ (private half never leaves it) and adds the entry it shows here by a commit. A message sealed to the lead and signed by a key listed here is that person's own word (admin/tools/inboxes.py drain checks the signature against this file as well as data/keys.json). Public halves only.

keys.name: Dinis Cruz
keys.how: Made by Dinis Cruz in his own browser at https://fringe.promptugal.news/me/ (work/26), protected by his passkey; he handed the public half to the lead in the lead's session (session_01Kw9UwCFpT9ihNBcQFxkomq) on 11 November 2026, about 12:27 UTC. The lead checked both keys parse and both fingerprints match their SPKI sha256.
